hints.title: Streaming Modulo Construction
hints.text: Accumulate the non-zero digits into an integer using modular arithmetic at each step.

hints.title: Sum Accumulation
hints.text: Compute the sum of all digits modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Modular Product
hints.text: Multiply both modular values and take the final result modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: length of digit string s
complexity.notes: Single pass left-to-right modular Horner accumulation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting large string to arbitrary precision integer without modulo overflows fixed width types.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for filtered non-zero string buffer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply modular arithmetic at each digit step to avoid large integer overflow.
